ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly high-intensity white pixel core (approx. 70-75% area) with high-contrast low-intensity black pixel boundaries and internal markings (approx. 25-30% area).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central zone. High-intensity white field is bordered by a continuous low-intensity black band along the leading and trailing edges. A discrete, circular low-intensity focal spot is present in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe. Vertical low-intensity linear streaking is concentrated around the median notch and the lower center of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 110-120 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with medium-frequency peaks; pixel amplitudes are more pronounced on the inner half of each lobe's trailing edge, smoothing out towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp upward convexity towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, high-contrast clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. A single, well-defined circular black pigmentation mark is isolated on the upper-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of sub-parallel, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) oriented vertically across the lower central fluke and diagonally across the mid-right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle encrustations on the lateral tips; multiple rake-mark patterns crossing the pigmentation on the right and central fluke regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular 'target' mark located on the upper portion of the left lobe pigmentation field.
